author: ZeeDeveel
text:
Just finished going through this journal in detail, saving all the
screens and studying them etc. This is my favourite journal on RTM; a
combination of skilled trading and a gift for explanations in clear
English (from an Aussie too!?). Thanks a bunch, this has cleared up so
much confusion for me, I feel like I have a strategy now, not just some
theories. This is a bit of a sappy post, but really it's necessary.
Thanks again and come post some more please!! :)

Oh and one question: I've seen you've taken some fakeout trades and
really got the entry within a few pips. Do you place a PO beyond the
high/low which you expect to be faked, or wait to see what happens
there? I know you said you don't use wicks anymore because they destroy
your R:R but it seems like sometimes you do on a FO? Perhaps wait for
the initial reaction and price to bounce back beyond the original
high/low that was faked before entering?

author: Bodostock
text:
Dear Pedini,

Great to see you back.

I have a couple of questions on your GBPUSD trade, hope you can help enlighten.

Based on what IF has always trying to impart - we need to study the past
 as in how decision are made, are they clean, where itself was reacting
to, how it leaves the zone etc and then the present as in approach and
reaction.

I see that yours is a touch-trade which reveals your confidence that the price would react to the local DP within your FTR.

Have you already decided that you will long at the FTR the moment when
it was created, even before we see how price coming down from the top?

If yes, does that mean you do not need to bother how price came back to
your FTR on approach as part of the trade criteria? If so, what gives
you such absolute confidence?

The next thing i like to ask is

1) as per my chart circled in green, is that a important DP?

2) i mean is that the DP that decided to engulf the origin of the supply DP at the left as marked by omidfxt?

3) but as i was typing, i think it was not. Could your FTR already
reacted to the DP that decided to engulf the origin supply DP which can
only be seen in LTF?

Thank you

Lots of questions there. Let me see.

I did not and don't make the decision to trade that FL when it is
created, nor do I any other FL. The price action after it is created is
very important. The main reason I took the trade is there was clearly
some untested orders and to make it even better there were a nice set of
 lows to fake below. It also looked like it could have been on the edge
of a potential range. This is why I was confident that price would
bounce. Once the bounce happened I was happy to sit and watch it for a
while to see where it went.

Your level circled in green will most likely hold some importance in a
lower timeframe, it doesn't look to amazing to me there though, however
it still has the potential to bounce price. Again, it depends how price
approaches it etc.

Peds
